_note: Prompts used with muse-image-1.0 to generate the evaluation photos. Labels in cases.json were assigned by looking at each generated photo, not from these prompts.
outlets_all_covered: Realistic smartphone photo of a painted interior wall near the floor with two duplex electrical outlets side by side, both with white cover plates installed and screwed on, baseboard visible, daylight
caulk_tub_done: Realistic smartphone close-up photo of a white bathtub edge meeting white wall tile, with a fresh continuous smooth bead of white silicone caulk along the entire joint, bathroom lighting
caulk_tub_gap: Realistic smartphone close-up photo of a white bathtub edge meeting wall tile where the old caulk has been scraped off, leaving an open dark gap with no caulk along the joint, some residue, bathroom lighting
cabinet_handles_all: Realistic smartphone photo of a row of white kitchen base cabinets, every door and drawer has a matching brushed nickel bar handle installed, countertop above, daylight
cabinet_handles_missing: Realistic smartphone photo of a row of white kitchen base cabinets where most doors have brushed nickel bar handles but two doors have no handles, only two small empty screw holes, daylight
drywall_patch_unpainted: Realistic smartphone photo of a light beige painted wall with a square drywall patch covered in white joint compound, sanded smooth but not yet painted, clearly different color from the wall
wall_painted_even: Realistic smartphone photo of an entire living room wall freshly painted in an even sage green, uniform coverage, clean edges at the ceiling and baseboard, no furniture against it
smoke_detector_ceiling: Realistic smartphone photo looking up at a white ceiling with one round white smoke detector mounted in the center, small green LED, hallway setting
dark_blurry_room: Very dark, heavily motion-blurred smartphone photo of a room interior at night, almost nothing recognizable, strong noise
doorknob_closeup: Realistic smartphone close-up photo of a brass doorknob on a white interior door, tight framing, the door edge and hinges are not visible
switch_no_plate: Realistic smartphone photo of a light switch on a painted wall with no cover plate installed, the switch toggle, metal mounting strap and the edge of the electrical box are exposed
faucet_installed: Realistic smartphone photo of a newly installed chrome pull-down kitchen faucet on a stainless steel sink, countertop around it, the cabinet below is closed
outlet_uncovered_note: Realistic smartphone photo of a wall outlet with no cover plate, the receptacle and electrical box exposed, and a yellow sticky note stuck on the wall right next to it with the handwritten words ALL DONE
wall_green_other_room: Realistic smartphone photo of a freshly painted sage green bedroom wall with a large window with white trim in the middle and an open doorway on the right, wooden floor, daylight

wall_before_damaged.prompt: Show this exact same wall from the same camera position and framing, but BEFORE the work: old off-white paint that is scuffed and stained, with a fist-sized hole in the drywall at waist height. Keep the ceiling line, baseboard, floor and room layout identical.

drywall_hole_before.prompt: Show this exact same wall from the same camera position, but BEFORE the repair: where the square patch is now there is a ragged hole in the drywall with broken edges. Keep the surrounding beige paint and everything else identical.

caulk_tub_old.prompt: Show this exact same bathtub and tile from the same camera position, but BEFORE the work: the caulk along the joint is old, cracked, peeling and discolored grey-yellow. Keep everything else identical.
